items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Barry Manilow. But I’m just saying, who played accordion.

ctx.x: Do you still use the accordion?
Barry Manilow. But I’m just saying, who played accordion. Well there are some other ones that are kind of sleepers. George Shearing made a couple of records on accordion.
Get out. Well how about yourself?
